setup_graph_parallel_groups: setup graph parallel and data parallel process groups for distributed training with a specified group size
setup_gp: setup graph parallel groups from a config dictionary with gp_gpus and distributed_backend keys
cleanup_gp: cleanup and destroy the graph parallel and data parallel process groups after training
reduce_from_model_parallel_region: reduce a tensor from the model parallel region using all_reduce across the graph parallel group
scatter_to_model_parallel_region: scatter a tensor to the model parallel region by splitting it across graph parallel ranks
